This catalog is a supplement to the F-1 Operations, Maintenance and Service Manual, Atari Publication Number TM-088. The purpose of this catalog is to provide you with the necessary information for ordering replace- ment parts for the F-1 game. When ordering parts from your distributor, give the part number, part name, page number of this catalog fram which you got the part number, and the serial number of your F-1 game. This will help to avoid confusion and mistakes in your order. We hope the results will be less downtime and more profit from your F-l game.
